name: Gender by Name (UCI Machine Learning Repository)

note: English given names with the number of people recorded bearing each, aggregated from
the civil registries of the United States, United Kingdom, Canada and Australia,
This is the keystone of the whole corpus and it was not obvious until it was measured.
Every locale's fallback chain ends at `en`, so English given names are what fifty-five
locales resolve to when they have none of their own. Building the corpus without
faker-js -- which is now possible to try, with `decoy-build-corpus --without
immediately on `person.first_name` in the first locale checked, because English had no
given names from any source. One list fixed every locale at once.
The obvious source was the US Social Security Administration, which publishes the
same data at greater depth and refuses every non-interactive request with a 403. That
is recorded in the strategy doc as a blocker; this dataset is the way around it, and
it is broader anyway -- four countries rather than one.
